sources.name: CountGD
sources.observedMechanism: Text/visual exemplars condition GroundingDINO-based object point proposals/counting. Single image example resizes 800/max1333 and uses CUDA.
sources.benchmarkBoundary: FSC-147 and related counting; not board-state values, object identity, phone speed or Terra recall.
sources.adopted: Physical unit definition and localization before count; optional future proposal baseline.
sources.notAdopted: Installing detector or treating predicted counts as hidden inventory.
sources.license: Repository MIT verified; model/data/upstream terms need separate check before adoption.

sources.name: VideoTree
sources.observedMechanism: Visual feature clustering followed by caption/relevance-based adaptive expansion. Read code calls a language model for relevance.
sources.benchmarkBoundary: Long-video QA, not exhaustive physical state; GPU feature and caption/model work is not cheap local frame filtering.
sources.adopted: Adapt to information gain rather than only equal time intervals.
sources.notAdopted: Per-frame VLM relevance or whole framework as capture prerequisite.

sources.name: ORB-SLAM3 keyframe decision
sources.observedMechanism: Keyframe admission considers tracked-map/new-close-point information and mapping availability as well as frame spacing.
sources.benchmarkBoundary: No paper runtime number or KeepBoard experiment claimed.
sources.adopted: Do not equate time/pixel difference with useful new information.
sources.notAdopted: Full 3D SLAM, map or IMU pipeline.
sources.license: GPL-3.0 repository metadata; not copied into product.

sources.name: OpenCV optical flow and planar registration
sources.observedMechanism: Sparse point correspondence and planar robust mapping, with assumptions and outliers.
sources.benchmarkBoundary: Camera motion compensation is not object-level static-state verification; upright pieces/lighting/repeated patterns remain problems.
sources.adopted: Conditional cheap geometry signal after simple selector, not required first slice.
sources.license: Official OpenCV docs; no code imported, runtime/dependency/license packaging to verify at implementation.

sources.name: ML Kit Text Recognition v2 input and realtime guidance
sources.observedMechanism: Focus/character pixel size matters; keep latest frames when analysis is busy.
sources.benchmarkBoundary: 16x16 character guidance is SDK-specific, not a Terra/dice cutoff; SDK not a React-web drop-in.
sources.adopted: Bounded local work and original-patch quality signals.
sources.notAdopted: OCR dependency or text confidence as whole-scene quality.
sources.license: Docs CC BY 4.0, examples Apache 2.0 as stated on page; SDK terms separate.

sources.name: SAHI sliced inference and postprocess
sources.observedMechanism: Slice coordinates map back to source; overlap candidates must be reconciled.
sources.benchmarkBoundary: Detection not generic VLM, not board-state/number correctness; standard box NMS can erase legitimate layers.
sources.adopted: Exact source transforms and separate whole/detail evidence.
sources.notAdopted: Any overlap implies identity or digital crop adds optical information.
sources.license: MIT source noted in prior pinned research; no product import.

sources.name: OpenAI Terra vision and pricing
sources.observedMechanism: Image detail and reasoning effort separate; image input and structured output supported. Multiple images bill input; limitations include small/rotated text, counting/spatial reasoning.
sources.benchmarkBoundary: Terra-specific image sizing formula not established from other model rows; official availability is not KeepBoard accuracy.
sources.adopted: Pin detail/effort/output, count all usage, distinguish multiple-image API from current one-image adapter.
sources.license: Hosted API terms, no new account, call or data upload.

localClaims.claim: Current generic prompt already asks every kind, small/overlapping/edge objects and preservation despite unreadable attributes.
Frozen 9 responses contain 353 raw and 353 normalized rows and completed status; no raw row drop/truncation in this set.
Historical selected scores and provider timings reproduced from fixed evaluation; partial AI references are not human full-scene GT.
Current selector rejects higher-motion frames and same-view frames before assessing any replacement advantage.
Risk first5s 0/20 selected, Chess first5s two selected; sharper same-view synthetic frame rejected as duplicate.
localClaims.limits: No mobile runtime, state certification, candidate-selector benefit or model quality tested.

localClaims.claim: Capture quality analysis uses long-side192 sample; stored camera JPEG keeps actual camera size.
Hosted batches pin sameStaticState as intent without visual proof; selected source IDs are finalized before job submission.
focused-provisional can prefer smaller same-original crop for known typed values; historical Sagrada numeric regression remains separate from detection recall.
Independent-view intake and parallel processing exist, but registered source/crop identity is not general cross-camera matching.
Progress preview is source overlay; final record auto-applies after commit and is editable, not a new mandatory approval queue.
Test whole-low enumeration and sparse unknown-row reporting separately before adding a detector/OCR prerequisite.
localClaims.unknown: New prompt effect and whole-scene precision/recall.

localClaims.claim: Best-frame selection/replacement is a narrower first acquisition change than semantic VLM frame scoring or full SLAM.
localClaims.unknown: Mobile cost, meaningful optical information gain and state-change error.
